I scrolled on screen record for 45 seconds and out of all the patterns, ONE was free and able to look at…. Halfway through my scroll. Not to mention there’s not even a way to filter the free patterns vs the pro patterns. It’s a cute app, and useful if you’re trying to learn new patterns… but don’t be surprised with 99.9% of the patterns are behind the paywall they don’t warn you about.

reviews.title: Over the AI

With that- not actually that many patterns for very basic ideas. The chat AI is horrendous. I couldn’t find the label for the yarn I used and couldn’t remember how much it was exactly but had a small range (150-250 yards). I put in the size calculator exactly what my project consisted of and it said I needed 4 times the amount of yarn. I already paid the subscription so oh well I’ll use it for what it can do but I feel like you’re better off buying a book for half the price of the yearly subscription. There are cute patterns but this app really advertises things that it doesn’t have and honestly a little bit of patience and YouTube is better than this. Happy crocheting!

reviews.text:
So when I got this app I was really excited, so at the beginning it’s all like perfect and fun and teaches u some like stitches, but then it began to tell me I had to pay and although it was a bit pricy compared to the other apps I have now I guess I didn’t rly care. So before paying I wanted to try out a pattern and I chose this like mango/peach there’s the choice to go through everything step by step or just have the written pattern, now as an experienced crocheter I chose the written pattern. Now I use US terms and not UK however when I first got the app it didn’t ask me what type of terms I wanted to use instead it just automatically does the one from your continent. So I was unaware of this and began my amigurumi so it told me to do double crochets(dc) like a million times, I thought strange but whatever and after a lot of round I asked Google AI what happened and it explained everything to me so I frogged the whole thing annoying but thats the life I chose. So I then asked Google how to switch the app to US terms and it explained it to me, but then when I was trying to do it I couldn’t find the like little button thing the I told Google and I had been using an iPad the whole time and it turned out u cant chance it on iPads and I was rly upset cuz my phone is used for other things. I was really upset about it and now I can t really use the app. All I’m asking is to change this detail please or else people might pay for no reason.

Thank you.

This app is NOTHING like the adds. When you start it’s supposed to teach u how to hold the yarn, which is fine      BUT after that it teaches u the chain thingy and it’s not helpful!!!!! If you’re a beginner like me, DO NOT try this app.😡😡😡😡😡

If u want 2 make it better, I could write a list.

reviews.title: Ok but needs more attention
reviews.text: I’ve had completed a number of patterns with YarnPal. However, there is patterns that don’t have all the sections- for example, ruby the bunny just has the pattern for her dress/skirt, not the bunny itself. I have identified a few mistakes in patterns too, and checked with AI and that instructs different to the written patterns. It has lovely patterns, it’s just a shame not all of them are accurate!

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.text:
The patterns are impossible to follow and the ai chat contradicts the steps, on more times than I can count it has told me to do something then hours later I have had to under everything because that one step they told me to take was wrong. The ai is useless and often makes mistakes with simple maths, for example it insisted that 8+3+7 equalled 15 until I proved it wrong, it then changed the whole pattern I was following, again having to undo all the work I had just done. 
For what was a hobby I usually find therapeutic this app has made it an infuriating task, I wouldn’t recommend it to ANYONE especially not a beginner. If I could leave 0 stars I would

reviews.title: Eh not great
reviews.text: Most of the items don’t have videos and the bay booties video doesn’t match the guidelines as far as rounds. The video is one round behind and then what’s suppose to be round 6 says conflicting things from the video and guidelines. Also not always clear from guidelines or video if we’re staying in the same chin space or it’s separate stitches :/ I’m becoming frustrated and disappointed with the app I paid for

reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.text: This app is so disappointing! It gives you a handful of patterns but when you want something different there is no way to change skill level. I’ve tried everything the internet has to offer as far as changing or editing my account to a more intermediate level and I can’t seem to do it. I’m not impressed and I tried to cancel and get a refund because I accidentally paid for the year and  I’m not able to do that either.  So many other apps that are far better in my opinion.

reviews.title: No search, save, or favorites
reviews.text: There’s no way to search for something, you have to go through entire categories. The only thing that “saves” is the one project you’re working on - you can’t save or favorite things you want to do in the future. There are videos for only a few select projects. The AI assistant has not once actually answered a question helpfully or correctly. All that being said, I gave YarnPal 2 stars because, of the 4-5 projects I tried, the one that had a video with it was actually OK. Though some steps were visually skipped, I could easily see what the creator was doing for most of the project.

reviews.title: AI
reviews.text: The amount of AI being used is very disappointing, more than half the picture prompts are clearly AI and if you follow the pattern it will more than likely not turn out like the pictures. Using AI instead of real fibre artists work is very sad taking away from artists livelyhood and ruining the art of crochet and knitting :/

reviews.title: Won’t be paying for the service
reviews.text:
Genuinely so disappointed. There is so much on here that doesn’t have video if you need additional help and there’s no actual written pattern to follow, it’s a step by step that’s like “chain 8” then go to the next page to see the next round. It makes no sense that they ask if you can follow a pattern and then don’t show any patterns. As soon as my trial is up, I’m not paying for it.

The chat is also AI which was really disappointing to see. Not that I was expecting a fully staffed team to be answering chats 24/7, but to have it be AI with and not have that clearly disclosed in the app preview was annoying to discover.

reviews.title: Wanted to like but…
reviews.text: I am not a crochet beginner, I have been doing it for years but wouldn’t call myself an expert, more of a confidence self taught dabbler. But these patterns are driving me batty! No yarn weight or how much you will need. Only shows step by step so you can read over the pattern first to see if you feel like doing that pattern, if the effort is worth the outcome or if there is a section you wouldn’t feel very confident doing without practicing that section first. Yes these are things I always do before starting a project. I like how many how to videos they have available, especially since I am an absolute beginner for knitting but if the knitting patterns are the same only show one step at a time this app will be deleted before the one week trial is up.

reviews.title: Not enough
reviews.text: Looked impressive but the information per item was not enough, it didn’t state the weight of yarn used apart from a couple of projects and didn’t state the amount of yarn needed for the item, one of the clothing patterns didn’t give sizes and the intro just stated chain how many you need, didn’t state it that was around the waist or length

reviews.title: The simplest feature is missing
reviews.text:
I tried the one-week free subscription to YarnPal and decided not to continue with a paid membership. The biggest issue for me was the lack of a search feature. If I want to crochet something specific, like an otter, or find a pattern using Tunisian crochet hooks, there’s no way to search for it directly.

The app mainly shows a gallery of photos that you scroll through and click on, which feels limiting. I also like to switch between knitting and crochet, but there’s no clear way to filter or distinguish between the two unless you already have a trained eye for how the finished piece looks. That makes the experience less user-friendly than I expected.

Additionally, the branding feels a bit misleading. The name “YarnPal” and the logo featuring knitting needles suggest a knitting-focused platform, but most of the patterns I saw were crochet-based.

Adding a search bar and filters for craft type and techniques would greatly improve the usability and overall experience.

reviews.title: Not free at all without committing to subscription!
reviews.text: When I downloaded this, I saw that it had in-app purchases. Fine. But when I’d downloaded it, the only way to access it was to a) get a 7 day trial with a commitment to sign up immediately for a year’s subscription of not cancelled, or b) opt for a month paid at £2.99 with a year’s subscription. Either way you have to committ to payment and have to remember to cancel within 7 days!!!

reviews.title: Not beginner friendly
reviews.text: This app was advertised as beginner friendly and that it had free patterns to follow, it has none of this! You have to pay to be able to use the patterns and basically everything else. The only things you get without paying are stitch tutorials, size calculator, chart symbol reader and how to fix. This is awful, ravelry has better quality’s and actuall offers beginner tutorials. Would not download nor pay for any of this!!

reviews.title: Very limited
reviews.text: This app is supposed to help you learn to crochet and knit. I can’t find how you get to the knitting section. Additionally there is only 4 starting projects where they show you step by step. After that there are very limited choices of projects and they throw you right into trying to read a pattern without teach you how to do it to begin with. At $40 this is a total rip off. Unless you want to crochet a bunch of animals even then this is not an app that teaches you much except chain stitch, single crochet and double crochet and that it’s. Not how to do much of anything else. I would like a refund.

reviews.title: Patterns Don’t Match Pictures
reviews.text: I was very excited to try this app out but was super disappointed.  I tried two different patterns and neither one matched the picture given. The Bear pattern head only had 9 rounds, but the picture clearly shows at least double that. I tried the giraffe as well and instead of the head having the snout incorporated into it, it was just round. Then it told me to attach the nose, but there was no nose pattern given to attach. Not worth the buy!

reviews.title: Payment
reviews.text: This is yet another app that does not make it clear that it is by subscription. I am trying to delete it, I do not want 7 days free, I want to cancel now! Nothing shows how to do it & nothing gives an option to do so.

reviews.title: VERY UNSATISFACTORY
reviews.text:
I have tried to view knit patterns without success! 
Also, I see that I was joined to your VERY unsatisfactory group.  I want my account credited IMMEDIATELY!  I have not gotten two cents with of information.  I tried REPEATEDLY to use your app, but to NO success.  I tried asking questions, but no success there either.  
You seem to emphasise crocheting.  That is absolutely of NO INTEREST, as I responded.
You need to be MORE precise in your advertising!
PLEASE respond to my request immediately, if you changed my account.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: The stuff on there is cute and all but the only thing I would say is you’ve got to pay to even look at the tutorial because it just shows you the key patterns what will you need? And what hook do you need? I’ve done crocheting sort of before, but I’m not very good at it. That’s why I got this app but you need to pay to even see the tutorial of how to do it. It literally just shows you what you need to get

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: At first I thought it looked really good, bought it and now that I’ve had a closer look I regret buying. I tried one of the patterns and it just didn’t make sense, almost incomplete. There also isn’t much variety, unless you want to make seasonal or animals, which I do not. I haven’t even tried the the AI pattern generator as I wouldn’t trust the pattern. Thinking of buying, save your money and head to a websites that offer free patterns, they are literally the same patterns.

reviews.title: Paid app flawed
reviews.text: I loved the idea of this app. I watched all 4 tutorials and even tried most of them. My videos for other things were not loading so I thought maybe I needed these to be completed before I could see other videos. However, it did not fix it. I also could not find a way to search for videos of things I wanted to make. It’s a free 7 day trial, then you pay monthly for it. It’s a good idea bc I learn better from videos, but it’s not executed great through this app if nothing will load for you to see or search.

reviews.title: Knitting
reviews.text: I thought when I downloaded this app I would be able to see some knitting patterns but all I have seen so far has been Crochet which I can not do and I am too old to try to learn how to crochet. I’m happier with knitting so if you want to learn to knit Don’t DOWNLOAD THIS APP AS IT IS MAINLY CROCHET.

reviews.title: Clothing patterns are useless
reviews.text: The clothing patterns don’t have any sizes on. There is guidance on how to scale up or down but you dont know what you are starting with so it’s pointless. I’ve started making a few but had to unravel them all as they were the wrong size

reviews.title: Image “Generation” Lie
reviews.text:
I am a VERY experience crocheter and I was excited. I’d subscribed to a year and canceled after using for 10 minutes. 

What a ridiculous scam. Pattern images are NOT being “generated”. Image generation should never produce the EXACT same image from two wildly different prompts asking for specifically different things. This is just a search engine looking at a bank of images, lying about generating an image based on your prompt. 

This seriously makes me angry because people do not understand AI, and these people are misrepresenting their product.

reviews.title: Illegal charge
reviews.text: I tried this app on a trial basis and I wasn’t happy with it. You can’t search for patterns just what they decide to put in the app. I canceled the trial before I was supposed to be charged. However, I was still charged. I contacted apple 2 x to rectify this and they denied refunding me. Then I tried contacting this company and they refused to respond. I don’t feel like I should be charged when I cancelled the free trial within the terms and conditions. As a company this should be made right.

reviews.title: Only for absolute beginners
reviews.text:
This app is a disappointment and I now regret buying it. 
Does not have a search option, you have to keep scrolling. Does not have separate crochet and knitting patterns- is the same pattern either crochet or knitting and one of them is not correct always! 
The language is confusing, the videos rarely work properly. 

I gave it 2 starts because if you are an absolute beginner you can use a couple of videos there, but you can also find free material! I’ve no idea why people gave it great reviews.

reviews.title: Fine app, Too much AI though!
reviews.text: I was looking for something just like this, and was so exited when I found yarn pal! But after I downloaded it, not only did I have to sit through a cutscene about "yarn yoga" (is it just me who's literally never heard of that??) but then I went to find a small pattern to start myself off, and get a feel for the app, and every single pattern I found was ai generated, at least the images were ai generated/enhanced, so I wasn't sure what I was actually going to make. Decided to throw together a little cup cozy in like an hour, and it turned out lopsided and nothing like the picture (I did use the correct yarn and hook sizes) it was otherwise fine, nothing outstanding. I was genuinely shocked when I realized this app has 11k 5 star reviews and turned out to be heavily AI.

reviews.title: Not what it claims to be
reviews.text: This app makes it appear as though you have access to countless patterns but actually the function is less useful than simply googling an idea. Most of the crochet patterns I wanted to search for were in fact knitting patterns and the instructions aren’t accurate. I am requesting a refund

reviews.title: Stitch Tutorials ok. Patterns not so much
reviews.text: I tried several patterns on this app and they are so poorly written and hard to follow. I’m an advanced crocheter. I’ve been doing this for 30 years. The instructions for the projects don’t make logical sense and when you ask the ai to clarify it just hallucinates answers. Example the Cat Set. I asked if you work each stitch into its own chain and then back down the other side to get started and it had me making clusters and working in the round. (Incorrect). The other cat ear beanie has a more logical start instructions, making you work the first round on both sides of the chain, but the pattern doesn’t produce the correct hat shape for cat ears and it’s way too small.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: 80% of the patterns are ai, you haven’t got a choice but to constantly press ‘next’ every single next step which is so time consuming rather than just reading the actual pattern
